$comment: Skill presets, Arch-style: take only what you need. ukiyo_skills {"action":"install","preset":"balanced"} copies them into .claude/skills and/or .agents/skills. simple/balanced/complete are for making games; engine is for working on ukiyo itself.

simple.description: Make and check a game: the loop, 2D drawing, input and testing.

balanced.description: Simple plus physics, game UI, sound, generated art and starting new games.

complete.description: Everything for games, including rendering internals, driving running games live and changing the Studio.

engine.description: Working on ukiyo itself: architecture and rules, renderers and protocol, hosts and the dev bridge, MCP tools and skills, the Studio.
